title: Defense Spending
question_text: How much should the government spend on the military?

stances.text: Increase military spending substantially, launching a major buildup to expand the armed forces and their capabilities.
Increase military spending moderately, growing the budget above inflation to keep pace with rising threats.
Hold military spending roughly flat, allowing it to rise only with inflation.
Reduce military spending modestly below current levels.
Cut military spending dramatically, roughly halving the budget or more.
